snippet.title: OUT NOW: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles Trailer
snippet.description:
The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles Trailer

The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles is a pixel-art dungeon-crawler RPG featuring roguelite elements. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510490/The_Crazy_HyperDungeon_Chronicles/

Players will explore intricate dungeons, fight enemies, and solve puzzles. 
The combat system offers a unique blend of turn-based tactics and arcade dynamism.
The game is a tribute to classic dungeon-crawler games, adapted for modern tastes: every run of the game presents unique challenges, strategy, and combat, offering a fresh experience for both veterans and beginners. Indeed, the layout of the rooms, the shape of the corridors, and the placement of monsters, traps, and treasures are reinvented every time, providing players with an ever-changing challenge. 

The game will offer a total of 50 levels, dozens of enemies, two different heroes and 3 combat styles. 

But don't be fooled by the seriousness of the challenge: the entire adventure is imbued with eccentric humour and sharp dialogues, rich in pop culture, nerd/geek references, and nods to classic video game lore, which, we hope, will capture the heart of every gamer!

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510490/The_Crazy_HyperDungeon_Chronicles/
